description: This file contains C++ source code implementing JavaScript bindings for the AAMP plugin within the WebKit browser environment. It manages injection and removal of JavaScript controllers based on URL host checks and provides a function to set HTTP headers for the plugin.

methods.name: LoadJSBindings
methods.description: Injects JavaScript bindings into the WebKit frame if conditions are met, based on URL host checks.

methods.name: UnloadJSBindings
methods.description: Removes JavaScript bindings from the WebKit frame if previously injected.

methods.name: CanInjectJSBindings
methods.description: Determines whether JavaScript bindings can be injected based on the URL host.
